name: Hastewire API
description: REST API for humanizing AI-generated text and detecting AI-written content. Authenticate with an API key (Bearer token) created in your Hastewire dashboard (https://hastewire.com/ai-humanizer/account/api-keys). Requests are billed in cents against your prepaid credit balance: 1 credit = $0.01, humanization costs 1 credit per 20 words ($0.50 per 1,000 words) and detection 1 credit per 80 words ($0.125 per 1,000 words). Minimum top-up is $5. No subscription or plan upgrade is required. There are no official client SDKs, batch endpoints, webhooks or async endpoints.
